Name: Kirill
Description: Darbuka Arabic brings together Arabic speech, automatic transcripts, and audio-quality measurements for speech recognition and text-to-speech research, with a focus on Egyptian and Saudi speech.
Paper Title: Darbuka Arabic: A Large-Scale Dataset for Arabic Speech Research
Abstract: Darbuka Arabic is an Arabic speech dataset comprising 943,731 clips and approximately 1,944 hours of audio, with a focus on Egyptian and Saudi speech. Each 2–20-second clip includes transcriptions from three ASR models, a PriorityROVER consensus transcript, quality measurements, dialect labels, and source provenance. Of the total audio duration, 98.01% achieves a predicted DistillMOS score of at least 3.0, and 83.59% exhibits inter-ASR consistency of at least 80%. Distributed as streamable WebDataset shards with accompanying analytical metadata, Darbuka Arabic supports ASR research and TTS data preparation through flexible inspection and subset selection.
